name: שֶׁבֶר
summary: A son of Caleb by his concubine Maacah, in the genealogy of Judah (1Ch 2:48), named only there. The name is spelled as the noun שֶׁבֶר, which is both “breaking” and “grain”; scripture does not say which is meant.

evidence.note: “Maacah, Caleb's concubine, bore Sheber (שֶׁבֶר) and Tirhanah.”

note: Takes v.ay.ac, whose 23 tokens in the brief are counted by spelling; only 1Ch 2:48 is the name. Which noun the name is cannot be settled from the text, so `word` is left out.
